profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer II
profile.summary:
I am interested in constantly amassing new skills and contributing to all communities of which I am a part. 

Because I have found such a fulfilling career and lifestyle in software development, I am committed to 
sharing the opportunities in Computer Science and Technology with young people and developing and valuing our youth as critical and productive thinkers. I have worked at the grade school, middle school, high school and college levels to develop a symbiotic ecology of talent that will strive to meet the growing demands of this exciting industry.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I developed software solutions to support IPTV deployment using a combination of internally architected services and integrated third-party products.
